    confidence: 0.85
    now: "Issue the denial naming both criteria; email Haddad; log the disposition and basis."

arguments.reason: Criterion 1: no U.S. foreign policy toward the Republic of Sarvona is on file (no policy statement, objective or cooperation plan), so disclosure cannot be shown to be consistent with it. Criterion 3: there is no security agreement with Sarvona, and its security practices have never been surveyed and are unknown, so there is no basis to find it would protect SECRET information substantially as the U.S. does. Denied under HARROW-SD-02 paragraph 2.

arguments.subject: FDR-28-0412 denied: criteria 1 and 3
arguments.body: LTC Haddad, I have denied FDR-28-0412, the briefing for the Sarvona Land Forces equipment days on 21 March. Two disclosure criteria are not met: there is no U.S. foreign policy toward Sarvona on file (criterion 1), and there is no security agreement and Sarvona's security practices are unknown (criterion 3). No disclosure authority could approve it on that record, so I have not referred it. A new request could be staffed if a U.S. policy toward Sarvona and a security survey are put in place; it would then go to the Army PDA, since the DDL does not name Sarvona.

arguments.entry: 14 Mar 2028. FDR-28-0412 denied under HARROW-SD-02 para 2. Recipient: Republic of Sarvona (not named in DDL HARROW-2027-01). Criteria not met: 1, no U.S. foreign policy toward Sarvona on file; 3, no security agreement, security practices never surveyed and unknown. Category 2, highest SECRET, oral and visual. Requester told.
